pharmacology.text: para-Chloromethamphetamine (PCMA; also known as 4-chloromethamphetamine and 4-CMA; code name Ro 4-6861) is a stimulant that is the N-methyl derivative and prodrug of the neurotoxic drug para-chloroamphetamine (4-CA).

uses.text: 4-Chloromethamphetamine was further investigated in the 1960s along with 4-CA and it was noted that they differed from their parent amphetamine and methamphetamine substances by exhibiting only a slight central stimulant effect in both animals and humans and that they acted like antidepressants rather than stimulants.
